{{Quote|<nowiki> 'I am cast upon the winds of space and time, like a planetesimal spun eternally between suns.' </nowiki>|[[I-5YQ]], explains how he came to be stationed at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] to [[Den Dhur]] by quoting ''Beach of Stars''|<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
'''''Beach of Stars''''' was an award-winning novel written by [[Kai Konnik]]. Konnik wrote ''Beach of Stars'' during his residency at [[Poloda Place]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Coruscant Nights II">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> and it won the [[Galaxis Award]] for best novel. ''Beach of Stars'' was among the 200,000 novels, [[Holoplay/Legends|holoplays]], poems and other media programmed into [[I-5YQ]]'s memory banks.<ref name="MedStar I" />
